Mahesh Soni vs The Assistant Commissioner Of Police on 27
December, 2024 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated : 27.12.2024
 Coram 
 The Honourable Mrs Justice L.Victoria Gowri 
 W.P. No.39716 of 2024
 and WMP.No.43012 of 2024
 Mahesh Soni ..Petition
 Vs. 
 1. The Assistant Commissioner of Police,
 Valluvar Kottam High Road,
 Ponnangipuram,
 Nungambakkam, Chennai-6. 
 2. The Inspector of Police,
 F-3, Police station,
 Ponnangipuram,
 Nungambakkam, Chennai-6. .. Respond
 Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind
 issuance of Writ of Mandamus forbearing the second respondent from
 interfering in relation to the running of their Restaurant premise 
 Brew Cafe along with Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or
 trace of Tobacco and Nicotine) at No.38/11 Status Quo building, Ste
 Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai-600 034. 
 1 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 

 For Petitioner : Mr.S.R.Rajagopal, Sr.C.
 For M/s.Praveenath Selvam
 For Respondents : Mr. K.M.D.Muhilan,
 Government Advocate (Crl. Side)
 Order
This writ petition has been filed seeking to forbear the second respondent from interfering in relation to the running of their Restaurant premise viz., DEJA BREW CAFE along with Herbal Mahesh Soni vs The Assistant Commissioner Of Police on 27 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70968451/
1 Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine) at No.38/11, Status Quo building, Sterling Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai-600 034.
2. The learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is ready to give an undertaking that he will allot a separate smoking area for serving of Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine) in his business premises. 
3. Per contra, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents submitted that even if they provide separate smoking space, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis permission under the Department of Food Safety is mandated. 
4. In view of the said submission made by either parties, there shall be a direction to the petitioner forthwith to make an application before the Department of Food Safety and obtain an appropriate permission for providing Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine). The petitioner shall also give an undertaking letter before the respondent police to have separate smoking area for serving Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine). On receipt of the said undertaking, the respondent police are directed not to interfere with the business premises of the petitioner after getting permission by the Department of Food Safety. 
5. It is made clear that the petitioner will strictly adhere the undertaking and will not violate it by taking advantage of the order passed by this Court. I also further make it clear that it will not prevent the respondent police for making the periodical inspection as to whether the undertaking is followed by the petitioner. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis L.VICTORIA GOWRI, J.
rli 6. With the above directions, the writ petition stands disposed of . No costs. Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
